question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Men, Teachers, Doctors

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab542dc73c010fbe2479e516896ceb33a8ddead8b335c48d580135c53757bd86.png]
solution:
From the given words:

Men, Teachers, Doctors 

We know that men can be teachers and doctors, doctors can be teachers and men & teachers can be doctors and men. Since all them are inter related,

The Venn diagram will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ede3c2b2b2885bdcd7d54a8585e977547769922e5d9717af3a8f42c0c5bc20a3.png] 

From the given figures, we can see that figure C is same as the Venn diagram obtained.

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
